allow: PowerShell($ProgressPreference='SilentlyContinue'; $x = \(Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ArduPilot/mavlink/master/message_definitions/v1.0/ardupilotmega.xml' -UseBasicParsing\).Content; $lines = $x -split "`n"; foreach \($p in @\('value="42424"','value="42425"','value="42426"','id="191"'\)\) { $m = $lines | Select-String -Pattern \([regex]::Escape\($p\)\) | Select-Object -First 1; if \($m\) { "=== $p ==="; $lines[\($m.LineNumber-1\)..\([Math]::Min\($m.LineNumber+22,$lines.Count-1\)\)] -join "`n"; "" } else { "=== $p NOT FOUND ===" } })
